title: An efficient stochastic generalized method of moments estimator for nonlinear moment models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12873v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the asymptotic properties of the nonlinear stochastic GMM algorithm proposed by Chen, Lee, Liao, Seo, Shin and Song for recursively estimating parameters defined by possibly nonlinear and overidentified moment restrictions $\E[g(X,\beta^*)]=0$. Each observation updates estimates of the moment Jacobian, inverse covariance matrix and Gauss--Newton preconditioner at a cost independent of sample size. For linear and nonlinear instrumental-variable moments, we derive an exact rank-two Sherman--Morrison--Woodbury update. The algorithm combines preconditioned stochastic approximation with iterate averaging. Under a preconditioned monotonicity condition, satisfied globally in linear models and locally around a consistent pilot estimate in general, we establish almost sure convergence and rates, as well as a functional central limit theorem with the efficient GMM variance. translated_title: 面向非线性矩模型的高效随机广义矩估计方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了由Chen、Lee、Liao、Seo、Shin和Song提出的非线性随机GMM算法的渐近性质，该算法用于递归估计由可能非线性且过度识别的矩条件 E[g(X,β*)]=0 所定义的参数。每处理一个观测，算法都会以与样本规模无关的成本更新矩雅可比矩阵、逆协方差矩阵以及Gauss-Newton预条件子的估计。对于线性与非线性工具变量矩，我们推导出精确的二秩Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury更新公式。该算法将预条件随机近似与迭代平均相结合。在预条件单调性条件下——该条件在线性模型中全局成立，在一般情形下于一致的初步估计附近局部成立——我们建立了算法的几乎必然收敛性及收敛速率，并证明了带有有效GMM方差的函数中心极限定理。这些结果要求矩函数具有四阶矩……
tldr: 本文针对非线性矩条件下的随机GMM算法，在预条件单调性条件下建立了几乎必然收敛性与收敛速率，并证明了具有有效GMM方差的函数中心极限定理，其单次更新成本与样本规模无关。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes almost sure convergence, convergence rates, and a functional central limit theorem with the efficient GMM variance for a nonlinear stochastic GMM algorithm whose per-observation update cost is independent of sample size.
